insights.summary: The agent demonstrated excellent problem-solving skills. It correctly identified the optimization target, applied the requested pattern (regex -> string ops), and verified the results. Notably, it handled environment-related import errors gracefully by creating standalone verification scripts, ensuring the logic was correct even when the full test suite couldn't run.
strengths: Adaptive testing strategy when faced with environment issues.
Comprehensive optimization (applied to both main and streaming methods).
Clear and thorough documentation of changes.
weaknesses: Did not resolve the root cause of the import errors (likely PYTHONPATH), relying on simulation instead.
